## Repurpose 0.1.0

**What it does:** One transcript to a LinkedIn post, Instagram caption with 3 hashtags, X thread and YouTube title and chapters. Human tone, no em dashes, limits checked.

**Install:** download `repurpose-skill.zip` below and follow the 3 steps in [the README](../../tree/main/tools/toolbox/repurpose), or run the [toolbox installer](../../tree/main/tools/toolbox#install-everything).

### New
- Builds a ready prompt with writing rules, the output format and [mm:ss] marks for chapters
- Works with Claude, any chat model (paste the prompt) or a local Ollama model
- `check` verifies sections, platform limits, exactly 3 hashtags, YouTube chapters, dashes and stock phrases

### Tested
- Linux (Python 3.13, ffmpeg 6.1). Windows commands are in the README and not tested on Windows yet.
